history.summary: Low-quantum $1.5M 3BR in a 2016 Punggol project with a standout 8.2%/yr URA resale CAGR on a deep 130-txn sample. But the 969 sqft footprint is a compact/efficient 3BR, the PSF 1548 sits ~4% above the project median, and the unit is on the Coral Edge LRT (not MRT) with reported traffic noise — a Neutral despite strong appreciation data.
history.rating_rationale: The appreciation (8.2%/yr, 130 txns) and $1.5M quantum are genuinely attractive and the LRT-network connectivity to Punggol MRT/PDD is real. But the negatives balance it: 969 sqft for a 3BR is tight (cramped layout risk, narrows family-buyer appeal), PSF 1548 is already ~4% above the project's own median rather than a discount, and reviews flag unbearable traffic noise plus a congested, no-open-area site. You're paying an above-median PSF for a compact unit relying on PDD spillover — fine, not cheap. Liquidity is good at this quantum but the unit is not the standout 3BR in the project.

history.summary: OCR Punggol 3BR priced slightly ABOVE recent comps — the value signal is an age-adjustment artifact, not a real bargain.
history.rating_rationale: The algo's -11.2% age-adj implies cheapness, but verification flips it: FLO's recent 3BR/969-sqft transactions averaged ~S$1,441 psf and even the top trade (a 969-sqft unit, Feb 2026) was S$1,519 psf — this listing at S$1,548 psf is at the high end, slightly above recent market, consistent with the +7.0% vs-cohort premium. So there is no margin of safety; the 'cheap' is purely the leasehold-age discount math. The 8.23% trailing CAGR (130 txns, genuinely deep) is real history but per the v3.4 backtest carries ~0 forward weight. OCR/D19 is the best forward region (~+4.0% realized) and the Cross Island Line / Defu area improvements help broadly, but buying at the top of the recent range neutralizes that edge. Fairly-to-fully priced → Neutral.
red_flags: Listing PSF (1,548) sits above the trailing 12-month average (~1,441) and the recent high (1,519) — paying a premium, not a discount
Algo 'cheap' read is driven by leasehold age adjustment, not verified transaction evidence
99-yr leasehold from 2016 TOP in a 530-unit suburban block — exit competes with abundant OCR supply
catalysts: OCR/D19 is the strongest forward region per the backtest (~+4.0% realized fwd)
Cross Island Line and Punggol/Defu connectivity upgrades support the broader area
